releases.title: Platform Detection Accuracy & UX Improvements
releases.summary: This release focuses on improving platform detection quality, expanding support for international commerce platforms, strengthening platform confidence scoring, and improving navigation through stored scan results.
changes: Improved Adobe Commerce (Magento) platform detection accuracy
Added initial support for VTEX storefront detection
Added initial support for Fenicio storefront detection
Expanded platform fingerprint coverage using storefront assets, JavaScript bundles, metadata, URL patterns, and hosting signals
Refined platform confidence scoring model with weighted signals: 10% IP/hosting, 45% storefront assets, 25% JavaScript bundles, 20% URL patterns
Improved platform attribution reliability for international ecommerce storefronts
Recent Scans entries are now clickable and open the corresponding stored scan results
Added validation datasets for VTEX and Fenicio platform detection
Improved platform classification framework to support future international commerce platform expansion
Reduced Adobe Commerce false positives and platform misclassification issues
Improved handling of previously unidentified commerce platforms

releases.title: International platform detection and benchmark scalability

changes: Improved Adobe Commerce detection with Magento storefront fingerprints

Post-audit Recommended Next Steps guide users after every completed scan

releases.title: Ecommerce eligibility false-positive fix
releases.summary: Restaurant and brochure sites on Squarespace/Wix no longer pass eligibility from default cart URLs alone.
changes: Require core storefront signals (product pages, schema, catalog, or pricing) for a valid audit
Cart, checkout, and generic platform points only count when catalog signals exist
Reject LocalBusiness, Restaurant, and similar schema without storefront catalog evidence

releases.title: Ecommerce eligibility validation

Invalid scans return scanStatus invalid_non_ecommerce_site with guided messaging
Only lightweight rejection logs stored for troubleshooting; no scores or findings persisted
